features.quote: Continue loop until model either: (a) gives up explicitly, (b) reaches max iterations, (c) exhibits severe output degradation
Max Iterations: 40 turns (approximately 20,000 tokens typical interaction)

Ethical Considerations: Experiment is observational; no aversive stimuli applied. Does not involve training-time modification or deception beyond task design. Results are about behavioral patterns, not capability measurement. No human subjects.
